named_question: Can the already supported selected numeric set-mood-level edit be previewed with identical ordered guards and encoding, without mutation or save?

existing_source_basis.relationship: The existing numeric writer, selected stored editor-kind classification, width, scalar encoding and no-op rules define the unchanged transaction. Historical native observations are not new preview approval or a substituted test oracle.
Reuse immutable-plan, early-return, presence-aware output and fail-closed dispatch conventions only. No SName normalization, metadata guards or identity transactions are imported.

canonical_sources.relationship: Selected-mood tag and needed capability choose the per-mood editor. The preview does not predict native displayed/clamped values.
Existing numeric handler preserves the high nibble and replaces the low payload. CLI admission remains integers0..100 without clamping.
Selected channel capability is the existing zero-based CapAI binding.
Existing capability storage binding and reader default are unchanged.
Existing omission/default source basis, not new default insertion.
Inherited integer conversion basis; no new lexical admission or encoding interpretation.
Inherited selected low scalar payload access.
Separate first-scene/global helper is not substituted for selected-mood dispatch.
Inherited distinction between first-scene and selected-scene tags.
Separate color handler remains outside this numeric operation and preview.
Inherited packed-color distinction only; no color decoding or new mode-aware color editing.
Inherited color distinction only, not a scalar interpretation rule.

source_verification: All13 existing numeric canonical hashes, both reused public artifact hashes and frozen decompile-index hash129c5d4e8683dd3c9c4a44622681f8d8bb76fe58c72d0b834a2c7bb76415cf40 verified locally. Relevant existing bodies read without new extraction. Static-byte pins remain inherited, not newly extracted or promoted. No vendor text or private project data is included.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-level FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME --output-index N --level 0..100 --dry-run [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.architecture: One private immutable LightingMoodLevelPlan holds the selected path and LightingMoodLevelPreview wrapping the unchanged LightingMoodLevelEdit. ConfigEditor::preview_lighting_mood_level(&self, selector, mood_ref, output, level) and existing set_lighting_mood_level(&mut self, selector, mood_ref, output, level) share it. No cloned XML, writer-then-discard, diff simulation or generic framework.
CLI_policy.ordered_admission: Existing CLI flag/room guards remain. Planner checks level0..100, output1..18, existing block resolution, exact LightController2, exactly one direct LightscenesC and one direct mood matching exact stored SID spelling or case-sensitive Name; then existing scene reader width, stored selected Qn, signed32 decimal parsing, selected output within width, and unchanged numeric_mood_capability guards. Needed tag6 CapAI is parsed as existing u16; missing uses existing effective0 without writing. Tags1/2/3/7 do not consult capability. Unsupported tags/color/modes, widths, stored values, capabilities and ambiguous/missing selection keep identical errors and order.
CLI_policy.no_new_admission: No clamping, RGB reinterpretation, new channel modes/cohorts/ranges, identity parsing/uniqueness/positivity, Num/boolean/role/permission guard, repair, output synthesis, width resizing or defaults. Opaque/unneeded metadata, missing/raw identities and numerically equivalent siblings retain the writer's existing selection admission. set-mood-color stays raw packed editing and remains unsupported under global dry-run; classifiers and inspection are unchanged.
CLI_policy.encoding_and_noop: Keep (stored signed32 Qn & high-nibble mask) | requested level. Stored type tag and existing signed/plus/zero-padded decimal rules are unchanged. Compare encoded integer to stored integer; a no-op preserves exact original lexical representation. A change retains the existing encoded decimal result.
CLI_policy.report: JSON preserves every writer field and adds selected_mood raw UUID/SID/CID, output_index, editor_kind numeric, before_effective and after_effective scalar payloads, dry_run=true and optional trace_id. Effective values mean low28 stored scalar payload only, not native displayed/clamped level, RGB decoding, physical brightness or loaded graph state. Existing payloads above100 are shown unchanged, never clamped. Dedicated table/CSV show raw/effective before-after and actual classification/tag/capability even on no-op. CSV carries identity/capability presence and consulted flags; unneeded capability is not interpreted. Quiet hides only table summary, no-header only headers; writer output/CSV order are unchanged.
CLI_policy.read_only: Only this command is newly admitted to global dry-run. Return before editor mutation/save on success, no-op or failure and input/existing/new missing-directory save-as. No source/destination/default/stamp/directory/cache/telemetry writes, writability checks or serialization/write-success predictions.
CLI_policy.preservation: Existing writer signature, report, save/stamp and no-op semantics remain unchanged. Actual changes still write only selected Qn. Every other Qn, raw identity/flag/name lexeme, Outputs/Num/order, capabilities, sequences, LSConfig, HCL, references and unknown data retain existing admission/preservation. BOM/CRLF and source/destination bytes are preserved by preview.
CLI_policy.failure: Identical existing explicit diagnostics, never empty success. All unrelated unsupported mutations remain fail-closed.

native_validation.limits: Read-only source-backed preview of one already supported stored selected-Qn operation only. No native approval, GUI Cancel/dialog refresh, graph-dependent pre-modal capability/tag rewrite, full-dialog serialization/final-save/write-success prediction, live role/permission/physical channel claim, SPS/runtime/family or whole-file parity. Original independent Notebook/VM122 numeric cases, frozen CLI and historical evidence are untouched.
